target: Elementor editor fallback warning and version-drift guard
objective: Verify that the widget handles Elementor editor API drift without silently losing state.
preconditions: Filter Controller editor integration can update widget settings.
The test can simulate or observe failed native Elementor panel refresh.
steps: Trigger a normal save/import path that refreshes settings natively.
Confirm no fallback warning is shown.
Trigger or simulate a failed native panel refresh path.
Verify frontend render still follows saved widget settings.
expected_result: Editor fallback is explicit and does not hide fragility from the user.
pass_criteria: fallback warning appears only when fallback is actually used.
warning explains that frontend output remains controlled by widget settings.
console errors are absent or documented.
the behavior is safe if Elementor updates internal editor commands.
